note: #3259 is labelled `crash` and the reported symptom is 'an assertion failure and then crash in TranslatePtrIfUsedByLoweredFn'. Per SKILL.md step 4 this predicate is deliberately signature-independent: the same defect surfaces as a trapped assert (0x80000003 / 0xE0000001) in an assert-enabled Debug build and as an access violation (0xC0000005) or a `llvm::cast<X>()` bad-cast E_FAIL in the Release builds that ship as releases, so a predicate keyed on the assert text -- or on `TranslatePtrIfUsedByLoweredFn` -- would score every release binary clean and manufacture a false 'fixed'. Equally, `nonzero_exit` is NOT the test: on Windows dxc returns E_FAIL (0x80004005) for ordinary diagnosed errors, and the *correct* behaviour for this repro is exactly such a diagnosed error (an amplification payload may not contain a resource), so a nonzero-exit predicate would score a correctly-fixed compiler as still crashing. CONTROL: control-scalar-payload.hlsl is the same shader with a `uint` payload instead of a `Texture2D` one; it is legal, must compile cleanly and must not match. See variant-control-scalar-payload-*.txt.
